Cancellation/failure outcome and observation commit together. First receipt also includes pending started observations before effects. Writes and queue acknowledgement can be retried without another ad request or reward.
Write failure while video is playing retains the observation in memory and does not interrupt playback. Background save retries; failed terminal transactions require the explicit whole-result retry.
Cold recovery only replays observed facts. It does not invent success, skip or failure for a missing final callback, replay ads or grant an unconfirmed reward.

Provider supplies network and ad-unit metadata at offer creation; Mock explicitly uses simulation/internal-demo, otherwise default unconfigured. Local unavailable/loading_timeout/presentation_failed categories are not real SDK error codes.
Pre-consent and legacy offers without saved context do not manufacture past analytics events.
limitations: An observation that has never reached durable storage cannot survive an immediate process kill; backup cannot invent a missing fact.
Real SDK final-outcome callbacks, provider metadata timing, SDK error mapping, transport acknowledgements, server deduplication and production dashboards remain unintegrated.
Application tests use controlled providers/identity storage and deliberate filesystem failures; no physical-device or exact instruction-boundary OS kill proof.

rewardLifecycleInitialFailure.reason: Attribution fixture changed boards while offer was unresolved. PlayerProgress.begin() intentionally runs interrupted reward recovery and cancels that offer. Corrected test observes real final signals first, blocks event delivery, then changes board/config and cold-recovers original attribution. No production change was needed; fourteen strong cases and final full suite passed.

originalAudit0210.finding: Startup missing distinct Loading/Brand Loading is a client implementation gap, not solely an external legal/permission dependency. GEN-08 verified is limited to the local pipeline and own-product history; formal difficulty and cross-product acceptance remain pending.

implementation: Loading waterfront page, separate cream brand page, then Welcome/remaining permissions. Brand content remains beneath Welcome; bundled theme assets warm before permissions.

Original composition retained; seated original CapyMascot is shown bathing, existing CapyFace replaces reference cat, and both text/wordmark use Capydoku. No reference-product or sleep-health claim reused.
Both display holds exclude background time. Stage and permission transitions wait for foreground; an already open system permission request is not cancelled by its inactive scene phase.

Concurrent begin/accept are coalesced. Successful consent precedes analytics enablement; each permission completion persists separately. A thrown/cancelled request or failed save does not mark completion or skip the remaining step.
Resource/permission failure is retryable, successful retry clears stale error state, and cold startup checks local resources again without re-requesting already completed permissions.
Production Release entry always disables test skip. Dedicated first-launch flag still overrides host-test convenience bypass.

changes: Track all three UIKit recognizer attempts from touchesBegan through reset, including single-tap dependency wait; a board owner and session identify input that blocks direct/hint/free/offer/runReward without blocking the current board action. No fixed double-tap timeout.
Cancel real recognizers and owner state on lock, board replacement, detach or dismantle; old callbacks cannot release another owner/session.
Separate configured level-start-offer visibility from enablement and remaining quota. Disabled/locked/exhausted remains visible, but cannot create a reward; hidden/global-ad-off stays absent.
Claimed and future check-in dates are disabled while preserving status artwork. Claimable date uses CapyButton focus binding and one activation callback.
Functional switch/check-in text uses darker theme-compatible colors; decorative colors unchanged.
limitations: Simulated overlapping input tests validate model policy; real UIKit regressions validate completed recognizers and resumed tools. Physical simultaneous multi-finger/ad and VoiceOver focus testing remain pending.
Visible-offer screenshots use explicit synthetic configurations. They do not establish original per-level availability, quantities or triggerOrder semantics.
Frozen restart/trigger-order behavior and reference audio remain unavailable. No invented configuration values replace them.
